description_en: Modifies the burstable clean bandwidth for an Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance
description_zh: 修改DDoS高防实例的弹性业务带宽增加值
name: ModifyElasticBizBandWidth

parameters.help_en: The burstable clean bandwidth. Unit: Mbit/s. The burstable clean bandwidth cannot exceed nine times the clean bandwidth of your Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance, and the sum of the clean bandwidth and the burstable clean bandwidth cannot exceed the maximum clean bandwidth that is supported by your instance. The value 0 indicates that the burstable clean bandwidth feature is disabled. You can disable the burstable clean bandwidth feature once a month
parameters.help_zh: 弹性业务带宽增加值。单位：Mbps。最大为实例业务带宽的9倍，且业务带宽总和（业务带宽+弹性业务带宽增加值）不能超过实例允许的最大值。 取值为0表示关闭弹性业务带宽，每月可关闭一次
parameters.name: elastic_biz_bandwidth

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/157459.html operation to query the IDs of all instances
parameters.help_zh:
DDoS高防实例的ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/157459.html查询所有DDoS高防实例的ID信息
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The metering method of the burstable clean bandwidth feature. Valid values:

month: the metering method of monthly 95th percentile
day: the metering method of daily 95th percentile
parameters.help_zh:
弹性业务带宽的计费模式。取值：
month：月95模式
day：日95模式
parameters.name: mode
